gate: G7 same-config medians reproducible across repeats
spec: Every same-configuration benchmark group's medians must agree: timing <=15% symmetric relative difference; memory bandwidth (B3/B5) <=20%; stored median must equal the independently recomputed median within 0.001%; >=10 finite raw samples; >=2 distinct record IDs per group; every pair compared (all-pairs); a single run never passes.

verified_source.grouping_note: G7 groups records by the SERIALIZED CONFIGURATION (r.configuration.dump()), NOT by experiment_id and NOT by (experiment_id, benchmark_id). Two records whose serialized configuration blocks are identical fall into the same group even when their experiment_id differs; two records that share an experiment_id but differ in configuration do NOT form one group. Independence inside a group is established by DISTINCT record_id.
verified_source.v1.9_delta: No source change. v1.9's REPORT explanation of grouping was incorrect (it described grouping by experiment+benchmark); the production implementation has always grouped by configuration.dump(). v2.0 corrects the explanation to match the code.

verified_behavior: telemetry/profiler excluded: kind != benchmark && kind != baseline -> continue; empty benchmark_id -> continue
only benchmark and baseline records qualify for groups
at least 10 finite raw samples required (validate_samples: size<10 fail, !isfinite fail)
stored median independently recomputed by recompute_median() and checked at 0.001% relative
at least 2 distinct record IDs per configuration group (set-based dedupe, then size<2 -> fail)
every pair compared (nested i<j all-pairs loop, no early exit after first passing pair)
overall_pass starts true and is only ever assigned false - a later passing group cannot overwrite an earlier failure; diagnostics accumulate
missing or invalid evidence fails closed: no statistics / not computed / <10 samples / bad median each set overall_pass=false
